Role: Systems Engineer
Location: Remote based out of PA, OH, OR MD

This role is 70% remote and a 30% travel/on-site schedule




We are Growers, We are Wholesalers, We are Producers, We Are Budtenders, We are Retailers, We are Partners, and We are Hiring




Holistic Industries is looking for a Systems Engineer to help keep our business connected, secure, and running smoothly. In this role, you'll be responsible for maintaining and optimizing our network infrastructure while ensuring strong performance, reliability, and security across multiple locations.




Your Impact

Design, collaborate, and maintain network infrastructure that supports business operations across the organization
Monitor network performance, traffic, and security, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact users
Troubleshoot network connectivity issues, performance bottlenecks, and system outages to minimize downtime
Implement and manage firewalls, VPNs, and other security tools to help protect company systems and data
Upgrade network hardware, firmware, and configurations to improve reliability and performance
Maintain clear network documentation, topology diagrams, and security protocols



Your Strengths

Strong understanding of networking concepts including LAN/WAN, DNS, DHCP, IPsec, SSL VPN, routing, switching, and network security
Experience working with routers, switches, firewalls, and network monitoring tools
Advanced Microsoft 365 knowledge and experience supporting business environments in the past 2 years
Natural problem-solver who can quickly diagnose and resolve technical issues
Bachelor's degree in a technology-related field preferred, or equivalent experience



If we are EMPATHETIC, HONORABLE & ACCOUNTABLE

And we grow ourselves and business with GRIT then we will be

CHAMPIONS OF CANNABIS


Why Join Us:

Holistic Industries offers a comprehensive benefits package, including competitive base pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage. We also offer a team member discount in our stores, a Health Savings Account, pet insurance, and a 401(K) with a company match. Additional benefits include company-paid short term and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance and mental health and urgent care services. Team Members can also take advantage of our referral program and generous paid time off (PTO).
